audit_note: This registry tracks public reproducibility without equating transparent proxies or open-model analogues with numerical reproduction on proprietary Anthropic models.

coverage_status_definitions.implemented-complete: All registered headline result families have a validated protocol at the stated mode.
coverage_status_definitions.implemented-partial: At least one relevant protocol exists, but the source's result set is not fully reproduced.
coverage_status_definitions.planned: The source is in scope, but no validated protocol currently covers it.
coverage_status_definitions.reference-only: The item is educational, methodological, strategic, tooling, infrastructure, or historical rather than one reproducible result set.

mode_definitions.exact-reproduction: Original/publicly equivalent model, data, metric, and protocol are matched within declared tolerances.
mode_definitions.open-model-analogue: The same directional hypothesis is tested on pinned open weights; not an original numerical reproduction.
mode_definitions.transparent-proxy: A fully transparent toy or mathematical system tests a structural claim or invalid inference.
mode_definitions.reference: Integrated as curriculum, methodology, tooling, or history without an empirical reproduction claim.
